fix(github): keep a panel crash inside the tab

A plugin tab body renders inside the right Sidebar with no error boundary of
its own, so one throw unmounts the subtree and the pane goes blank — the whole
window when the failure reaches React's root — with nothing to read.

Wrap the panel in a boundary that names the thrown message, says it belongs to
this plugin, and offers a retry, so a rendering failure is diagnosable from the
pane instead of from a black screen.

27f5a3ef23d5bdc10543ed998d12d44eabdc47b4.message:
fix(github): hold the credential store through an injection

The lazy lookup alone still asks `ctx.get`, which sees only services the
context can already reach. The documented way to consume a service that may be
composed around the plugin is to declare it: a `ctx.inject(['credentials'])`
callback fires once the provider mounts, clears the reference when it goes
away, and both the auth bridge and the token reader share that one getter.

A test drives the real route handler with a store in the injected context and
checks the panel is told the store is writable; the injection list assertion
now names `credentials` too.

lines: - * @param {(name: string) => unknown} getService guarded service lookup.
